description: Registry on_load ordering invariants (Issue #65). Verifies the strong-guarantee: a module MUST NOT become visible to discovery APIs until all on_load callbacks have completed successfully. On callback failure the module MUST NOT become visible and the registry MUST emit apcore.registry.module_load_failed.

test_cases.description: After register() returns successfully, the module MUST be observable via list(), get(), and get_definition(). on_load MUST have completed before any discovery API can return the module.

If on_load raises, the module MUST NOT become visible via any discovery API. The registry MUST emit apcore.registry.module_load_failed with the full normative payload, and register() MUST re-raise the original exception unchanged.

on_load_raises.message: Failed to reach upstream during initialization

expected.registration_error_message: Failed to reach upstream during initialization

data_contains.error_message: Failed to reach upstream during initialization

test_cases.description: Two concurrent register() calls for the same module_id MUST result in DUPLICATE_MODULE_ID for one of them (the in-flight loading set rejects the second). The successful one MUST complete normally; the rejected one MUST NOT side-effect the registry.

Callbacks for distinct modules MAY run concurrently. The strong-guarantee invariant is per-module. Two registrations of different IDs with overlapping on_load delays MUST both complete and become visible.

expected._note: If callbacks were globally serialized the wall clock would be >= 100ms; the assertion confirms per-module parallelism.
